adjudications.rationale: Google reports establishing its Douglas County presence in 2003 and building and opening the data center in 2007. With the county panel beginning in 2001, only two pre-anticipation calendar years exist, which is insufficient for the prespecified five-year baseline and meaningful pretrend diagnostics.
